fields.name: shipToTab
fields.label: Ship To
fields.sourceQuote: On the Company Locations page, select the Ship To tab.
fields.notes: Tab control on the Company Locations page. UI widget category not stated by the corpus beyond 'tab'; fieldType left as unknown per graph convention for tabs.

fields.name: billToTab
fields.label: Bill To
fields.sourceQuote: On the Company Locations page, select the Ship To or Bill To tab.
fields.notes: Second tab, named alongside Ship To in the delete and export procedures. The add-address procedure only walks through the Ship To tab explicitly ('To add a ship-to address:'); the corpus never shows a distinct 'Add New Bill To Location' window name even though the field table (VAT ID note) implies the same form is used for bill-to.

fields.name: newButton
fields.label: New
fields.sourceQuote: Select New to open the Add New Ship To Location window.
fields.notes: Opens the Add New Ship To Location window (per admin-guides, also invoked for adding a bill-to address: 'Add one or more shipping addresses by clicking Ship To and then New.'). Role gate (tool-wide): requires Invoice Configuration administrator or Invoice Configuration (Restricted) administrator role (required-roles-476a5f62.md).

fields.name: modifyButton
fields.label: Modify
fields.sourceQuote: Select the address and select Modify
fields.notes: Alternative trigger for the same action: 'Double-click the address directly.' Opens the Modify Ship To Location window.

fields.name: removeButton
fields.label: Remove
fields.sourceQuote: Select Remove. The following confirmation message appears:
fields.notes: Supports selecting one or more addresses first ('Select the address or addresses.'). Deletion is a soft delete: 'The address remains available and can be reactivated by entering the same Address Code. The system creates a new record.'

fields.name: removeConfirmYesButton
fields.label: Yes
fields.sourceQuote: Select Yes to remove the address from the Company Locations page.
fields.notes: Confirms the 'Remove selected Company Locations' confirmation dialog raised by the Remove button.

fields.name: importButton
fields.label: Import
fields.sourceQuote: Select the Import button. The Import Ship To Locations window appears.
fields.notes: Opens the Import Ship To Locations window. Distinct from importSubmitButton, the in-window button that actually performs the import.

fields.name: downloadImportTemplateLink
fields.label: Download the import template
fields.sourceQuote: Select Download the import template link if you want to download a template with the field names already filled in.
fields.notes: DOCUMENTED GAP: the corpus never lists the template's column names anywhere for this page's own import (distinct from the Purchase Order import's 210/220 record formats, which are a different import mechanism and not this page's template).

fields.name: browseButton
fields.label: Browse
fields.sourceQuote: Select Browse and locate the file that you want to import.
fields.notes: Opens a file picker; the next step ('Select the file and then select Open.') is the OS file-open dialog, not a Concur Invoice control, but is recorded as an admin-facing step in the numbered procedure.

fields.name: openButton
fields.label: Open
fields.sourceQuote: Select the file and then select Open.
fields.notes: File-picker Open control invoked from the Browse step; part of the documented numbered procedure.

fields.name: importSubmitButton
fields.label: Import
fields.sourceQuote: Select Import.
fields.notes: The in-window submit control of the Import Ship To Locations window (distinct from importButton, which only opens that window). Produces the Import Summary page.

fields.name: importSummaryCloseButton
fields.label: Close
fields.sourceQuote: Click Close.
fields.notes: Closes the Import Summary page. After closing, status appears in the 'Ship To Locations import history' section of the Import Ship To Locations page.

fields.name: exportAllButton
fields.label: Export All
fields.sourceQuote: Select the Export All button.
fields.notes: Available on both the Ship To and Bill To tabs ('select the Ship To or Bill To tab' precedes this step); produces an Excel spreadsheet of all addresses on the selected tab.

fields.name: saveButton
fields.label: Save
fields.sourceQuote: Select Save to enter the new address into Concur Invoice.
fields.notes: Same control also documented in the edit procedure with the shorter phrasing 'Select Save.' (edit-a-shipping-or-billing-address-c8138913.md), used to commit the Add New / Modify Ship To Location window.

fields.name: addressSearchField
fields.label: Ship To Address / Bill To Address
fields.sourceQuote: start entering the company name in the Ship To Address or Bill To Address field
fields.notes: AMBIGUOUS PAGE OWNERSHIP, recorded per instructions rather than dropped: the topic never says this field lives on the Company Locations page itself, only that a type-ahead list shows 'the company name and the full address details' plus 'the default address' when a user types a company name into a Ship To Address / Bill To Address field. This could be the Company Locations search box, OR the Ship To/Bill To selector shown when creating a Purchase Request (end-user context) -- corpus does not disambiguate. Search tip corroborated in admin-guides: 'Be sure to type the Name value (for example, Triton, and not the Address)... Alternatively, you can click the down arrow to return a list of all system addresses from which to choose' (set-a-default-shipping-and-billing-address-f772bed1.md).

fields.name: addressName
fields.label: Name
fields.sourceQuote: A unique name that identifies a specific address.
fields.notes: Required. Row in the 12-row Add New Ship To Location field table (indented markdown table, grep -cE '^ *\|' = 39, not grep -c '^|'). This is the value shown when choosing a default shipping address in Profile > Profile Settings > Invoice Preferences, and when selecting the value for Bill To in a policy. Tip: 'The system searches for your location by using the Name value.'

fields.name: addressCode
fields.label: Address Code
fields.sourceQuote: This is the external identifier used by the customer's financial system to identify a specific address.
fields.notes: Required. 'This value is identical to the External ID field used in the Bill To and Ship To record sets of the Purchase Order import.' Used as the reactivation key on delete (re-enter same Address Code to restore a soft-deleted address) and as the identity-matching key against the PO import's 210/220 records (see how-company-locations-works-with-the-purchase-order-import-ed09e36a.md) and against Peppol invoice ship-to codes (limitations-f5fac4b5.md).

fields.name: addressLine1
fields.label: Address 1
fields.sourceQuote: Address 1 of the complete address.
fields.notes: Required.

fields.name: addressLine2
fields.label: Address 2
fields.sourceQuote: Address 2 of the complete address.
fields.notes: Optional.

fields.name: addressLine3
fields.label: Address 3
fields.sourceQuote: Address 3 of the complete address.
fields.notes: Optional.

fields.name: cityField
fields.label: City
fields.sourceQuote: The city within which the address resides.
fields.notes: Required.

fields.name: postalCodeField
fields.label: Postal Code
fields.sourceQuote: The postal code of the address.
fields.notes: Required.

fields.name: countryCodeField
fields.label: Country Code
fields.sourceQuote: you must use 2 character ISO code
fields.notes: Required. Full note: 'If you are using the import template to import company locations, you must use 2 character ISO code.' No enumerated code list is attached to THIS field by the corpus -- the corpus's one 249-row country-code catalog (country-code-list-8b3e2eda.md) explicitly scopes itself to 'the country code list that you use when creating the vendor import file', a different import; wiring it to this field would be an unsupported inference. UI widget type (free text vs. dropdown) is not stated.

fields.name: stateProvinceField
fields.label: State/Province
fields.sourceQuote: The state or province within which the address resides.
fields.notes: Optional.

fields.name: emailAddressField
fields.label: Email Address
fields.sourceQuote: The email address of the contact at the company location.
fields.notes: Optional. Per the revision-history topic (company-locations-8b49554d.md) this field was added later (April 2018) rather than present from launch, though its exact enumerated wording is not re-quoted here since it is a dating note, not a field definition.

fields.name: vatIdField
fields.label: VAT ID
fields.sourceQuote: This is only applicable on the bill-to address and required by some European countries.
fields.notes: Optional overall, but the field's own note restricts practical applicability to the bill-to address ('The VAT of the buyer.'). This is the one field in the table whose applicability differs between the Ship To and Bill To tabs -- the per-tab field set is NOT identical.

fields.name: addAsShipToLocationCheckbox
fields.label: Add address as a Ship To Location as well
fields.sourceQuote: Select (enable) this check box if you would like to populate the ship-to address with the same address information as the bill-to address.
fields.notes: Optional. Only meaningful on the bill-to form (copies the bill-to address into a new ship-to record). No enumerated Yes/No value pair is stated -- it is a single check box, not a value set.

dependencyCandidates.condition: One or more shipping addresses must be created via Company Locations before a single address can optionally be assigned to a Purchase Request user through the Employee Import.
dependencyCandidates.sourceQuote: Add one or more shipping addresses by clicking Ship To and then New.

dependencyCandidates.condition: The Employee Import's Default Shipping Address field (360-level record set) is populated with the unique location code that identifies an address already created in Company Locations.
dependencyCandidates.sourceQuote: This field uses the unique location code provided by the client that identifies the default shipping address associated with the imported user

dependencyCandidates.condition: The Purchase Request user's self-service Default Shipping Address selection (Profile > Invoice Preferences > Purchase Request) draws its list from addresses created using the Company Locations tool.
dependencyCandidates.sourceQuote: Note the availability of addresses created using the Company Locations tool.

dependencyCandidates.condition: An administrator assigning a shipping address on a user's behalf, via Administration > User Administration > Invoice Preferences, selects from the same set of available addresses created in Company Locations.
dependencyCandidates.sourceQuote: select one of the available addresses

dependencyCandidates.condition: When the admin selects Country and State/Province while adding a Tax Authority, Concur Invoice pulls the ship-to information from Company Locations to determine whether a transaction is domestic or foreign and which tax authority/rates apply.
dependencyCandidates.sourceQuote: Invoice will pull the ship-to information from the Company Locations page in Administration

dependencyCandidates.condition: The ship-to Address Code maintained in Company Locations must match the ship-to address code on invoices arriving via Peppol, or invoice creation fails.
dependencyCandidates.sourceQuote: The company ship-to address code maintained in Company Locations in Concur Invoice must match the ship-to address code in the invoices coming from Peppol

dependencyCandidates.condition: A Purchase Order import 210 (bill-to) or 220 (ship-to) record whose Address Code and External ID match an existing Company Locations record updates that address record in Company Locations on import.
dependencyCandidates.sourceQuote: Identical records are those that share the same Address Code (in Company Locations) and External ID (within the associated record in the PO import).

PAGE-OWNERSHIP EXCLUSIONS (deliberately NOT emitted as fields of this page): (1) the three 'change-ship-to-or-bill-to-address' topics (18a4dbb6, 2c926795, 564e516a) describe an end-user Change/Edit control on the Purchase Request or Purchase Order window, not a Company Locations admin control -- none of the three mentions Company Locations, so they were read and excluded rather than mis-homed; (2) the PO Bill-To (210) and Ship-To (220) import record formats are a DIFFERENT import (the Purchase Order import) with its own 'Future Use 1-10' compressed range -- they populate Company Locations records per how-company-locations-works-with-the-purchase-order-import-ed09e36a.md but are not this page's own Import button/template, so their field catalog and compressed range belong to whatever future page owns the PO import, not here; a dependencyCandidate records the relationship instead; (3) the 249-row country-code-list-8b3e2eda.md catalog is explicitly scoped to 'the country code list that you use when creating the vendor import file' -- captured as out of scope for this page's Country Code field rather than wired to it. DOCUMENTED GAP: the Company Locations page's own import-template column list is never enumerated anywhere in either guide directory (import-shipping-or-billing-addresses-601c2549.md only names the 'Download the import template' link). UNRESOLVED/AMBIGUOUS: addressSearchField (search-for-a-ship-to-or-bill-to-address-1d864cfe.md) may belong to this page's own search box or to an end-user Purchase Request address selector -- corpus does not disambiguate; emitted with a flag rather than dropped. List-page columns (sortable/selectable) for the Ship To / Bill To address grids are not documented anywhere in either directory -- the only stated UI feedback is 'The new address appears as a row on the Company Locations page,' so no column fields are emitted. Role gate (Invoice Configuration administrator / Invoice Configuration (Restricted) administrator) applies to the tool as a whole per required-roles-476a5f62.md and is not repeated as a distinct field-level control on every row.
